items.title: Will Shade and Dewey Corley Interview, 1960-05-25
items.q: I started in with Benny Ramey, Will Welton, myself, and another fella called Roundhouse. But his name was Elijah.

ctx.x: I see. Well, now you yourself, did you start out alone, or did you start in with somebody when you started making money?
Well, when I first started making money, I started in with Benny Ramey, Will Welton, myself, and another fella called Roundhouse. But his name was Elijah.
And what all did they do?
